<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="fLWa0SOxZQ68Ls6SBkPo"> <mxGraphModel dx="2531" dy="1001" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
' ============================================================
' Diagrama de Casos de Uso — Sistema Imobiliário
' ============================================================

title Diagrama de Casos de Uso — DW2 Imobiliária

left to right direction

skinparam monochrome false
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam actorStyle awesome

skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #EAF2F8
 BorderColor #2874A6
 ArrowColor #566573
}

skinparam package {
 BorderColor #7F8C8D
 BackgroundColor #F8F9F9
}

actor \"Visitante\" as Visitante
actor \"Corretor / Admin\" as Corretor

rectangle \"Sistema Imobiliário\" {

 package \"Consulta Pública\" {

 usecase \"Consultar imóveis\" as UC01 <<RF04>>
 usecase \"Filtrar imóveis\" as UC02 <<RF06-RF11>>
 usecase \"Visualizar detalhes\ndo imóvel\" as UC03 <<RF05>>
 usecase \"Visualizar localização\nno mapa\" as UC04 <<Mapa>>
 }

 package \"Gerenciamento de Imóveis\" {

 usecase \"Cadastrar imóvel\" as UC05 <<RF01>>
 usecase \"Editar imóvel\" as UC06 <<RF12>>
 usecase \"Excluir imóvel\" as UC07 <<RF13>>
 usecase \"Gerenciar disponibilidade\" as UC08 <<RF14>>
 usecase \"Gerenciar imagens\" as UC09 <<RF15>>
 }

 package \"Serviços auxiliares\" {

 usecase \"Validar dados do imóvel\" as UC10 <<RF16>>
 usecase \"Consultar CEP (ViaCEP)\" as UC11 <<RF17>>
 }
}

' ============================================================
' Visitante
' ============================================================

Visitante --> UC01
Visitante --> UC02
Visitante --> UC03
Visitante --> UC04

' ============================================================
' Corretor / Administrador
' ============================================================

Corretor --> UC01
Corretor --> UC02
Corretor --> UC03
Corretor --> UC04

Corretor --> UC05
Corretor --> UC06
Corretor --> UC07
Corretor --> UC08
Corretor --> UC09

Corretor --> UC11

' ============================================================
' Relacionamentos UML
' ============================================================

UC05 ..> UC10 : <<include>>
UC06 ..> UC10 : <<include>>

UC05 ..> UC11 : <<include>>
UC06 ..> UC11 : <<include>>

@enduml
",
